title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-18
lineage: CD -> EAC(secure, offset corrected) -> TLH(flac encoding) -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture with audible Pigpen organ and rare acoustic Truckin', highlighted by strong Not Fade Away and St. Stephen performances despite occasional vocal low‑mix.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard that brings Pigpen’s organ forward and offers an unusually clear version of the rarely heard acoustic Truckin' and Operator, though vocals can be a bit recessed and some listeners note overall fidelity issues. Musically the show shines with standout acoustic numbers like Not Fade Away, St. Stephen and Cosmic Charlie, and the electric set is praised as “fire,” making it a valuable 1970 snapshot despite mixed audio quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are split between high praise for rare songs and organ mix and criticism of overall listenability; the average star rating is ~3.1, so a mid‑range score reflects the mixed show and recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Vocals are sometimes low and overall fidelity is uneven, but Pigpen’s organ is unusually forward and clear; occasional distortion noted by a reviewer.

standout_songs: Going Down the Road Feelin' Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: The acoustic set is praised as impressive and flows into a high‑energy electric set that many reviewers describe as “fire,” giving the concert a strong overall pacing.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ is unusually forward and consistently in the mix, a rarity for 1970/71 recordings.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy (Kreutzmann) keeps a solid beat that reviewers specifically note.
